metadata.description: Plugins for NoteMeHere, a personal Notion replacement with an MCP server: capture, find and edit your pages from the agent you already use. Installable in Claude Code and Codex CLI.

plugins.name: notemehere
plugins.description: The NoteMeHere MCP server plus two skills: capture a thought, decision or meeting notes into the right page, and find and read pages back. Connection is approved in your browser, no keys to paste.
